correctness.rationale: For L>=4 all eight Moore neighbors are distinct, and exactly three successor neighbors lie in each adjacent successor-colored row. Signed edge differences satisfy the exact integer telescoping identity d_i^+=d_i+u_{i+1}-u_i, as proved by separating d_i=-1,0,+1. The explicitly derived local sign rules show monotonicity and opposite-direction collisions. The only recurrent states are pure-gradient unit shifts or three uniform fixed words. Every stripe word reaches this set by finite-state eventual periodicity. Winding conservation, exact gradient-vector reconstruction with three initial colors, binary pure-gradient combinatorics, roots-of-unity identity and Möbius inversion prove all counts for every L. The actual verify.py script independently checked complete state graphs for L=4..10, full Moore dynamics for L=4..6, and exact finite identities; those checks corroborate rather than replace proof.

value.rationale: The critical straight-band propagation threshold yields a natural invariant stripe subsystem of the widely studied cyclic-dominance torus. Exact winding is a global integral that partitions the basins of all initial stripe words by their actual eventual wave type, not merely by a local spectral test. Closed all-length recurrent and primitive temporal-cycle counts reveal exponentially many distinct high-winding waves and reduced periods beyond sampled three-front states. Together the classification and exact natural dynamical invariants provide a reusable benchmark for sampling and symmetry-resolved period studies; they are not an arbitrary finite parameter slice.
